View 1C: Burma Teak & Rattan Cane Detail

text.tspan: Close-up joinery detailing showing hand-stretched natural cane weave
mounted in solid Burma teak mortise and tenon frame.

svg.text: CRAFT SPECIFICATION: Seasoned timber at 12% moisture content; local Mirpur joinery craft.

text.tspan: 1. Truth in Advertising: All 3 angles depict an AI-generated architectural exploration study, not a constructed client
commission. The disclaimer badge is rendered permanently across every client-facing presentation.
2. Spatial Claims Scoured: Blanket unsupported claims (such as '80% open floor space' or 'guaranteed zero additional
costs') have been removed entirely. All descriptions now express qualified design intent.
3. Structural Feasibility: While geometry and material dimensions are realistic for Dhaka apartments, actual execution
requires on-site structural engineer validation prior to construction.

svg.text: 03. Studies 02 & 03: Heavy Cooking Kitchen & Master Platform Bedroom
কনসেপ্ট ডিজাইন · AI ভিজ্যুয়ালাইজেশন · বাস্তবায়িত প্রকল্প নয়
Concept 02: Dhanmondi Heavy Cooking Utility Kitchen

text.tspan: Resilient design tailored for heavy spice and oil cooking. Features honed black granite worktop,
high-suction exhaust hood niche, and dedicated dual LPG cylinder compartment with floor-level
ventilation louvers.

svg.text: SAFETY NOTICE: Dedicated LPG cabinet geometry is an architectural layout concept; requires certified gas line installation.

Concept 03: Uttara Master Suite Platform Bed & Slatted Wardrobe

text.tspan: Calm sleeping environment integrating a low-platform oak bed, integrated warm LED cove
illumination, dust-tight slatted wardrobe doors, and a compact study alcove.

svg.text: JOINERY SPECIFICATION: Soft-close Blum hardware with acoustic felt backing behind slatted panels.
04. Physical Material Specimen Board & Local Sourcing Directory

text.tspan: Dense hardwood naturally resistant to
termites and seasonal humidity warping.
Sanded to 320 grit with matte polyurethane
seal.
Flexible, breathable rattan wicker woven
in traditional hexagonal pattern. Allows
continuous air circulation across
cabinets.
Vapor-permeable mineral finish that
prevents tropical mold growth behind wall-
mounted joinery. Subtle natural depth
under sunlight.

svg.text: SOURCE: Local Stone Yard / Imported Slab

text.tspan: Stain and heat resilient surface capable
of handling turmeric, mustard oil, and
boiling cookware without etching.
Studio signature green applied to metal
accents, structural joinery framing, and
brand focal points. Grounding and
tranquil.
